ai.literal: Daytime conquers owl crow enmity will conquer to kings is needed time.
ai.translation: A crow can defeat an owl during the day. For kings who wish to conquer their enemies, choosing the right time is essential.
ai.modern: பகல் நேரத்தில் ஒரு காக்கை கூகையை வென்றுவிடும். அதுபோல பகைவர்களை வெல்ல நினைக்கும் அரசர்களுக்கு ஏற்ற காலம் அறிவது மிகவும் தேவை.
ai.explanation: The couplet uses a simple observation from nature to illustrate the importance of timing. An owl is naturally stronger than a crow, but during the day, the owl is blind and vulnerable, allowing the weaker crow to defeat it. The word 'பொழுது' (time) is the central concept, emphasizing that success depends not just on strength but on choosing the right moment. Therefore, kings who wish to overcome their enemies must wait for the opportune time to strike.

ai.literal: With the season to match acting, wealth without leaving binding rope.
ai.translation: Acting in harmony with the right time is the rope that binds wealth to you so it never departs.
ai.modern: ஏற்ற காலத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு செயல்படுவது, செல்வத்தை நம்மை விட்டு நீங்காமல் கட்டிவைக்கும் கயிறு ஆகும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of timing in any endeavor. The poet compares acting in accordance with the right season or time to a strong rope. This rope securely binds success and wealth to a person, ensuring that prosperity never leaves them.

ai.literal: Difficult actions they say exist-do? with instruments time having known if one does.
ai.translation: Are there any actions said to be impossible? Not if one acts with the right instruments and knows the right time.
ai.modern: தகுந்த கருவிகளுடன் ஏற்ற காலத்தை அறிந்து ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், செய்வதற்கு அரிய செயல் என்று சொல்லப்படுவது எதுவும் இல்லை.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of combining the right tools with the right timing. The word 'கருவியான்' refers to the necessary instruments or means, while 'காலம்' refers to the appropriate moment. When an action is performed with both, even tasks considered impossible ('அருவினை') become achievable. The rhetorical question 'உளவோ' implies that no such impossible tasks exist under these conditions.

ai.literal: World even if desired will be achieved, time having considered with place if done.
ai.translation: Even the whole world can be won if one acts after considering the right time and choosing the right place.
ai.modern: தகுந்த காலத்தை அறிந்து, ஏற்ற இடத்தோடு பொருந்துமாறு ஒரு செயலைச் செய்தால், உலகத்தையே அடைய நினைத்தாலும் அது கைகூடும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the power of combining the right time with the right place. The verb 'கருது' appears twice with slightly different senses: 'கருதினும்' means 'even if desired or intended', while 'கருதி' means 'having considered or calculated'. The word 'ஞாலம்' means the entire world, representing the highest possible ambition. 'கைகூடும்' literally means 'will join the hand', signifying successful achievement. By carefully calculating the fitting time and acting in the proper location, even the greatest of goals becomes attainable.

ai.literal: Time having considered they will wait unperturbed, the world those who desire.
ai.translation: Those who desire to conquer the world will wait unperturbed, biding their time.
ai.modern: உலகத்தை ஆள நினைப்பவர்கள், அதற்கான சரியான காலத்தை எதிர்பார்த்துக் கலங்காமல் காத்திருப்பார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the patience required for great ambitions. The word 'ஞாலம்' means the world, and 'கருதுபவர்' refers to those who aim to conquer or rule it. To achieve such a massive goal, they will not act hastily or get perturbed ('கலங்காது'). Instead, they will calmly wait ('இருப்பர்') for the right time ('காலம் கருதி') to act.

ai.literal: Energy possessor's restraint, fighting ram for attacking retreating nature it has.
ai.translation: The restraint of an energetic man is like a fighting ram stepping back to strike.
ai.modern: ஊக்கம் உடையவன் தகுந்த காலம் வரும்வரை அடங்கி இருப்பது, சண்டையிடும் ஆட்டுக்கடா தன் பகையைத் தாக்குவதற்காகப் பின்வாங்கும் தன்மையைப் போன்றது.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains the strategic patience of an energetic person. The word 'ஒடுக்கம்' (restraint or shrinking back) describes how a capable person might temporarily hold back and wait for the right time. This is compared to a 'பொருதகர்' (fighting ram) which steps back ('பேரும்') not out of fear, but to gather momentum for a powerful attack ('தாக்கற்கு'). The imagery clearly distinguishes strategic delay from cowardice.

ai.literal: Suddenly right-then outwardly they-will-not-fume; time having-watched, inwardly they-will-fume, the-wise.
ai.translation: The wise will not suddenly show their anger on the outside right away; waiting for the right time, they will keep their anger burning inside.
ai.modern: அறிவுடையவர்கள் தமக்கு ஒரு தீங்கு நேர்ந்த உடனே வெளியே தெரியும்படி கோபப்பட மாட்டார்கள்; தக்க காலம் வரும்வரை கோபத்தை மனத்திற்குள்ளேயே அடக்கி வைத்திருப்பார்கள்.
ai.explanation: This couplet explains how wise people handle provocation. The word 'வேர்த்தல்' literally means to sweat, which is used here as a metaphor for fuming with anger. Instead of bursting out ('பொள்ளென') and showing their anger externally right away, the wise keep their anger burning inside. They wait patiently for the right time to act.

ai.literal: Foes if seen, let one bear; end time if seen, downward will become head.
ai.translation: When you meet your enemies, bear with them patiently. When the time for their end comes, their heads will fall to the ground.
ai.modern: பகைவரைக் காணும்போது அவர் அழியும் காலம் வரும்வரை பொறுமையாகப் பணிந்து நடக்க வேண்டும்; அவர் அழியும் காலம் வந்ததும் அவர் தலை கீழே விழும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet advises strategic patience when dealing with enemies. The word 'சுமக்க' means to bear or carry, implying one should endure the enemy's presence submissively until the right moment. 'இறுவரை' refers to the time of their end or vulnerability. When that time is seen, 'கிழக்கு' (which here means downward rather than east) describes how their head will fall. The imagery contrasts the temporary burden of bearing the enemy with their sudden, inevitable defeat.

ai.literal: for attaining / rare thing / if it occurs / at that very moment / for doing / difficult / actions (do)
ai.translation: When a rare opportunity presents itself, use that very moment to accomplish tasks that are otherwise impossible to do.
ai.modern: கிடைப்பதற்கு அரிய வாய்ப்பு கிடைத்தால், அந்த வாய்ப்பு இருக்கும்போதே செய்து முடிப்பதற்கு அரிய செயல்களைச் செய்து முடிக்க வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet emphasizes the importance of seizing the right moment. Opportunities that are hard to come by do not last long. Therefore, when such a rare chance occurs, one must act instantly to complete difficult tasks that cannot be done at any other time. The repetition of the word 'ariya' (rare or difficult) highlights both the scarcity of the opportunity and the greatness of the deed.

ai.literal: Heron be-like folding time-at, then its strike be-like fitting place-at.
ai.translation: During the time of waiting, be still like a heron with folded wings. When the fitting moment arrives, strike swiftly like its peck.
ai.modern: காத்திருக்க வேண்டிய காலத்தில் கொக்கைப் போல அமைதியாக இருக்க வேண்டும். ஏற்ற காலம் வந்ததும், அந்தக் கொக்கு இரையைக் கொத்துவதைப் போல விரைவாகச் செயல்பட வேண்டும்.
ai.explanation: This couplet uses the vivid image of a heron hunting to teach the strategy of timing. A heron stands perfectly still with its wings folded (கூம்பும்) while waiting for prey, showing immense patience. When the right moment comes, it strikes with lightning speed (குத்து). Similarly, one must wait patiently without drawing attention when the time is not right, and act decisively and swiftly when the opportune moment arrives.
